verdict.rationale: Stripe Directory is documented as helping developers and AI agents find external providers for a task and follow the supported path to provision or use them, and a 'stripe-directory' agent skill appears in the live well-known skills index. MPP's validator also tests 'discovery', and ACS lets agents discover seller products. However, the Directory evidence is a single one-line claim and never says it indexes machine-payable APIs (MPP/x402) specifically. Missing for 10: documented directory contents and schema, an explicit link between the Directory and payable MPP/x402 services, a machine-readable discovery index of payable endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can query it.
